interpretation: Cross-sectional volume pressure persistence. A positive value means volume has stayed high versus peers over the recent window; the long-short result suggests persistent volume intensity carried short-horizon continuation or liquidity premia in this sample.
risk_notes: Numerically unusual because zscore(volume) can be negative and product can flip sign or explode. Keep this as a research factor and inspect value distribution before production use. Near-duplicates: ts_product(zscore(volume), 20/30).

risk_notes: Highly correlated with ts_min(ts_alpha(volume, cap, 21), 21). Treat the 21/21 expression as a parameter variant, not an independent factor.
